name: pages-data-loading
goal: Page data loading uses a reusable accessible status until the matching history and revision are ready

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Replace plain history/revision status text with one accessible reusable visual loading component; retain until matching data is ready and remove on completion/error.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing shell pieces fixture copies static loading text; current browser matrices wait for content and never hold index/revision requests. Extend canonical catalog host browser coverage with delayed requests and lifecycle assertions at three viewports.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Test-only commit 284d7156c fails the decorative indicator assertion. Controlled red record 54d91fc0d18e20e808f7d8f925cb78fab7c0c5c0085afbfbef3ed84dff77031f retains six before captures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Generated LoadingState through Harness, delegated its visual implementation to Claude Opus 5.5, and integrated both waits at 7464a62aa without changing fetching, routing or errors.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged six browser cases pass on 7464a62aa. Matched green ce861adcf6482638a0df99eed545772b870a803bee50ceb102e7ed58a4596ba1 retains six captures and references controlled red 54d91fc0d.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: All 689 Reports tests, formats, types, lint and build pass; audit passes after preserving failed task fixture outputs outside source. Root type/lint/format/audit and 20 focused guards pass. Thirteen browser cases and live latency/loading-to-content flow pass. CLI/native suites deferred; final committed capture retained separately.
